chunks: It is not your wealth and children that will bring you closer to Us, except those who believe and do the right. These will be given a two-fold reward for their deeds, and will dwell in peace in the high empyrean.
ai.seo_question: What brings a person closer to God according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to critique the pre-Islamic and contemporary reliance on lineage and material accumulation as markers of divine favor, emphasizing instead that faith (iman) and righteous action (amal) are the true criteria for nearness to Allah. The promise of 'doubled reward' (jazaa al-dubul) highlights the abundance of divine grace for those who combine belief with practice, securing them in 'al-ghurafat' (high chambers), a term frequently interpreted by scholars like Allamah Tabatabai as denoting the elevated spiritual stations of the Ahl al-Bayt and the righteous. This underscores the Shia principle that true nobility is spiritual and ethical, not merely genealogical or economic.
